profile.name: Karthik Chandrasekaran
profile.tagline: Building high-performing engineering teams and intelligent systems that scale.
profile.summary: Engineering leader, technology enthusiast, and polyglot programmer working at the intersection of people, platforms, cloud architecture, and applied AI.

focusAreas.title: Engineering leadership
focusAreas.description: Creating clarity, growing leaders, and building teams that can deliver ambitious outcomes sustainably.

focusAreas.title: AI & information retrieval
focusAreas.description: Exploring LLM systems, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, relevance, and evaluation.

focusAreas.title: Cloud architecture
focusAreas.description: Designing distributed systems, microservices, and cloud platforms with reliability and operability in mind.

publications.title: We’re Just Scratching the Surface of What AI Agents Can Do for Service Reliability
publications.description: Why modern systems excel at detecting problems quickly but still struggle to make immediate action safe, and how AI agents can help close that gap.

publications.title: The Moving Target: Why Evaluating RAG Is AI’s Quietest Hard Problem
publications.description: Why evaluation—not retrieval—is the real bottleneck in production RAG, and why trustworthy systems need continuous measurement across retrieval quality, generation quality, cost, and drift.

publications.title: What Conflict Resolution Taught Me About Building AI
publications.description: An engineering leader’s perspective on disagreement as useful information, psychological safety, power dynamics, missing context, and a practical diagnose–prepare–engage–repair framework.

publications.title: Bridging Retrieval Performance and Learning Outcomes: An Integrated Offline and Online Evaluation Framework for Retrieval-Augmented AI in Higher Education
publications.description: Co-authored with Gothai Sundaram, this preprint proposes an integrated framework connecting offline retrieval metrics with staged, online evidence of student learning outcomes.

publications.title: LLM Evaluation Is a Manufacturing Quality Problem. We’re Treating It Like a Software Unit Test
publications.description: A manufacturing-quality approach to enterprise RAG evaluation using offline golden datasets, online telemetry, and continuous measurement of context precision, faithfulness, and answer relevance.

publications.title: Evaluating Retrieval and Search Systems for Real-Time Mortgage Underwriting
publications.description: A framework combining offline and online evaluation for retrieval systems in high-stakes workflows.
